title: IIT Hyderabad Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Research Associate Posts
description: The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT Hyderabad) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Research Associate Jobs. Candidates who have qualified for the Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering can use this opportunity and apply for the IIT Hyderabad Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. The application process has already started.
